messages:
jordan: Heads-up: scheduled external security scan against staging Friday. Proposal: a 3-hr "corridor" 09:00-12:00 PDT. They requested KMS encrypt/decrypt on a single test key and an assume-role for API calls. Any objections?

meera: Fine with corridor. We must scope to one key and use ephemeral creds. No key policy changes allowed.

carl: I'll own the ephemeral role issuance. Recommend TTL 45m and explicit allow for kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333333:key/staging-scan-key. Deny kms:PutKeyPolicy/kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion.

infra: We'll land a small terraform change to create role and an IP whitelist. Example tester flow:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::333333:role/staging-scan-access --role-session-name scan --duration-seconds 2700
```
PR will be tagged "pt-scan" for fast track.

ops-bot: automated: CloudTrail export scheduled to s3://audit-lockbox/staging-scans/1976543210 at 12:10 PDT (immutable 90d).

jordan: Need an evidence checklist: CloudTrail events for kms and assume-role, VPC flow logs for test hosts, app traces correlated by trace-id. Pack into ticket per finding.

meera: Agreed. Also set an alarm: >30 kms:Decrypt attempts/min from a single principal -> notify but only page on critical threshold (>100/min).

carl: During corridor, deploy freeze 08:30-12:30 to reduce noise. I'll post a note in #releases.

pagerduty-bot: reminder: oncall will be paged only for severity >= high as flagged in triage ticket.

jordan: Retest plan: vendor will re-run specific findings for up to 2h within 5 business days after fix. Keep same role/key for parity.

infra: I'll add read-only CloudTrail viewer role for reviewers (no key-write perms).

jordan: Action items recap:
- infra: terraform role + read-only viewer + IP whitelist (PR by Wed EOD)
- carl: ephemeral issuance runbook and TTL config (Wed)
- meera: evidence template & ticket fields (Wed)
- ops-bot: confirm export & immutability (Wed)

ops-bot: bridge created: https://infra.company/bridges/staging-scan-1976543210 (automated)

jordan: OK if no blockers by EOD tomorrow we lock the corridor. Thanks. :thumbsup:
